My plot is very small, just 0.05 hectares, and I am planting cassava and cocoyam together like I always do here in the South East. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer, but I will put small NPK to help the yam and cassava, and I will spread the goat droppings and kitchen ash I have saved at home. I use the cassava stems from last year's harvest — they grow well enough for me, and buying improved cuttings is not easy in my village. With my age and only me working, I will do most of the work myself, maybe call one of my grandchildren or a neighbor's boy for the ridging and weeding.
